title: Define reviewed per-phase execution and review policy
body:
## Outcome

Replace the current phase DAG schema with work phases `understand`, `decompose`, `plan`, `test_design`, `implement`, and `publish`, plus policy-selected review gates.

## Acceptance

Treat shared initialization as an invocation precondition. Define each phase's execution and review contracts declaratively, including required review mode, independence, assignment group, model/effort routing, root approval and applicability. Default `test_design` to independent review and `implement` to independent acceptance/entropy review. Validate custom policy, stale open-goal evidence on policy change, and lossless open-goal adoption; preserve closed goals until reopening. Update the shipped template and tests.
